title: Smooth repository chat typing and reduce autosave churn
summary:
Repository chat should feel responsive while typing: fewer debounced PUTs and log noise, and the assistant transcript should not re-render on every keystroke. Autosave to `.relay/repository-chat.json` stays, with longer debounce and explicit flush on close/send/clear.
- Longer debounced persist plus flush on panel close and send/clear
- Memoized transcript vs composer so draft updates stay local
- Safer first-load hydration when typing starts before GET completes
Validate with focused renderer tests and manual typing in a project with a long assistant answer.
context: User reported chat typing causes visible panel rerenders and frequent INFO logs for PUT /api/projects/repository-chat. Intake confirmed autosave and panel-local rerenders are mostly by design; goal is smoother UX without removing persistence. Related streaming UX work (tkt_01ks7dand93t0q183ks5eja51x) is completed and separate.
researchFindings: src/renderer/src/App.tsx:309 defines REPOSITORY_CHAT_PERSIST_DEBOUNCE_MS = 400; persist useEffect (2731-2750) debounces saveRepositoryChatMutation.mutate to PUT /api/projects/repository-chat.
useSaveRepositoryChatMutation (src/renderer/src/lib/relayQueries.ts:502-505) has no onSuccess cache invalidation; board refetch is not the cause of typing churn.
RepositoryChatPanelContent (App.tsx:2348-2609) renders transcript MarkdownBlock list and draft Textarea in one function; draft prop changes re-render all assistant MarkdownBlock instances.
MarkdownBlock (src/renderer/src/components/MarkdownBlock.tsx:439) is not memoized; parseMarkdownBlocks runs on each parent render.
Hydration useEffect (App.tsx:2702-2729) depends on draft/messages/threadId; line 2705 skips server hydration when draft.trim() before query success, risking lost persisted draft on fast typing.
Panel unmount on closeRepositoryChat (App.tsx:6054-6065) clears debounce timeout but does not flush pending signature; closing chat can drop last unsaved draft.

Backend: projectEndpoints.saveRepositoryChat -> FileSystemStorage.saveRepositoryChat writes .relay/repository-chat.json (src/http/resources/projects.ts, src/storage/filesystem.ts, tests/repository-chat-store.test.ts).
requestLoggingMiddleware (src/http/middleware/requestLogging.ts) logs every request at INFO, making autosave PUTs very visible in dev logs.
requirements: Keep autosave to .relay/repository-chat.json; do not remove PUT persistence.
Increase typing debounce to ~1500-2000ms and flush pending state on panel close, send, and clear so drafts are not lost.
Typing in the composer must not re-render the assistant transcript/MarkdownBlock list when messages are unchanged.
Fix pre-hydration race so typing before GET /api/projects/repository-chat completes does not permanently skip server draft restore.
Reduce dev log noise from autosave without hiding other API request logging.
No board refetch or RelayApp-wide rerender regression while typing in repository chat.
implementationPlan: Extract repository chat persist helpers (signature, debounce constant, flush via refs) from RepositoryChatPanel into a small renderer module; raise debounce to 1800ms.
Wire flush on panel unmount, submit (after clearing draft), clearChat, and wrapped onClose before parent hides the panel.
Hold saveRepositoryChat mutate in a ref so persist effect deps do not churn on mutation status transitions.
Split RepositoryChatPanelContent into memoized transcript and composer subtrees; transcript props exclude draft.
Refactor hydration into a one-shot effect on query success/projectPath with a userEditedBeforeHydrationRef guard instead of draft-in-deps skip logic.
Downgrade or skip INFO logging for PUT /api/projects/repository-chat in requestLoggingMiddleware.
testPlan: Add tests/repository-chat-persist.test.ts for signature equality and flush scheduling behavior.
Add tests/repository-chat-hydration.test.ts (or renderer test) asserting server draft applies when user typed before query success.
Extend tests/ticket-draft-ui.test.tsx to confirm RepositoryChatPanelContent still renders transcript/composer markup.
Add request-logging test asserting repository-chat PUT is not logged at INFO.
Run node tests/run-tests.mjs and manually type in repository chat with a long assistant answer; confirm smoother textarea and fewer PUT/log lines.
acceptanceCriteria: During continuous typing, PUT /api/projects/repository-chat fires at most about once per 1.5-2s idle window, plus one flush on close/send/clear.
Assistant transcript does not visibly flicker or re-scroll on each draft keystroke when messages are unchanged.
Opening chat after typing before initial load still restores persisted draft from server when local state was empty.
Closing chat without waiting for debounce still persists the latest draft/messages.
Board and ticket views do not refetch or rerender due to repository chat autosave.
Dev console no longer spams INFO lines for each autosave PUT.
assumptions: 1800ms debounce is acceptable default within the 1500-2000ms range from intake.
React.memo on a new transcript subcomponent is acceptable; no project-wide memo convention exists yet.
Autosave PUT logging can move to debug or be omitted at INFO without a user-facing log-level setting.
implementationNotes: RepositoryChatPanel is conditionally mounted in RelayApp (App.tsx:6054-6065); unmount cleanup is the right flush hook when panel closes.
saveRepositoryChatMutation status is not used in JSX today, but mutation object identity in effect deps may still cause extra effect runs—stabilize with refs.
Completed feature tkt_01ks7dand93t0q183ks5eja51x covers streaming/thinking only; do not regress streaming handlers in RepositoryChatPanel.

leanTasks.title: Tune repository chat autosave debounce and flush
leanTasks.summary:
Make autosave less chatty while keeping drafts durable. Debounce moves to ~1.8s with explicit flush when the user leaves the panel or finishes an action.
- Export persist helper with signature dedupe
- Flush on unmount, send, clear, and close
- Stabilize mutate ref to avoid extra effect churn
leanTasks.context: First slice: reduce PUT frequency without losing draft data on fast panel close.
leanTasks.goal: Less frequent autosave PUTs with reliable flush on important lifecycle events.
requirements: Set REPOSITORY_CHAT_PERSIST_DEBOUNCE_MS to 1800 (exported from persist helper module).
Implement flushRepositoryChatPersist using refs for latest projectPath/threadId/messages/draft.
Call flush on panel unmount, submit, clearChat, and onClose wrapper before parent hides panel.
Keep signature dedupe via repositoryChatStoreSignature so unchanged state does not PUT.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing continuously produces at most one PUT per ~1.8s idle window.
Closing panel or sending message persists latest draft even if debounce timer has not fired.
Persist effect does not re-subscribe on save mutation status changes.
implementationPlan: Create src/renderer/src/lib/repositoryChatPersist.ts with signature, debounce constant, and flush/save helpers.
Refactor RepositoryChatPanel persist useEffect to use helpers and mutate ref.
Add flush calls in submit, clearChat, onClose wrapper, and unmount cleanup.
Add tests/repository-chat-persist.test.ts and register in tests/run-tests.mjs.

leanTasks.title: Isolate repository chat transcript from draft re-renders
leanTasks.summary:
Stop draft keystrokes from re-rendering assistant Markdown answers. Split the panel into memoized transcript and composer subtrees.
- New RepositoryChatTranscript (memo)
- New RepositoryChatComposer for textarea/options
- RepositoryChatPanelContent wires both
leanTasks.context: Addresses perceived page rerender: transcript MarkdownBlock reparses on every draft change today.
leanTasks.goal: Draft typing updates only the composer subtree.
requirements: Extract transcript rendering (messages, pending/thinking/error) into React.memo component without draft prop.
Extract composer form (textarea, options, actions) into separate component that receives draft and onDraftChange.
Keep existing RepositoryChatPanelContent export API stable for tests in tests/ticket-draft-ui.test.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing draft alone does not change transcript component props when messages/pending/error are unchanged.
Existing ticket-draft-ui repository chat markup tests still pass.
Manual typing with long assistant answer does not flicker transcript or reset scroll.
implementationPlan: Add RepositoryChatTranscript.tsx with memoized message map and MarkdownBlock rendering.
Add RepositoryChatComposer.tsx for textarea and footer controls.
Slim RepositoryChatPanelContent in App.tsx to compose the two children.
Update/extend tests/ticket-draft-ui.test.tsx if import paths change.
assumptions: React.memo is acceptable as first renderer memo usage in this area.

leanTasks.title: Fix repository chat pre-hydration draft race
leanTasks.summary:
Ensure server-backed draft still loads if the user types before the initial repository-chat query finishes. Replace draft-dependent hydration skip with explicit edit tracking.
- One-shot hydration on query success
- userEditedBeforeHydrationRef guard
- Tests for early-typing scenario
leanTasks.context: Hydration effect at App.tsx:2705 treats non-empty draft as reason to skip loading store from server.
leanTasks.goal: Server draft restores correctly unless the user has intentionally edited local state.
requirements: Remove draft from hydration effect dependency-driven skip logic.
Track first local edit before hydration completes; only skip server apply when that ref is true.
Preserve existing projectPath reset behavior (applyEmptyRepositoryChatState on path change).
acceptanceCriteria: Simulated test: query resolves after local draft typed from empty initial state still applies server draft when user had not edited.
After intentional edit before hydration, server values do not overwrite local draft.
implementationPlan: Add userEditedBeforeHydrationRef set in onDraftChange before repositoryChatPersistReadyRef is true.
Split hydration into effect that runs once per projectPath when repositoryChatQuery.isSuccess.
Add tests/repository-chat-hydration.test.ts covering early-typing vs intentional edit cases.
Register test in tests/run-tests.mjs.
assumptions: Server draft should win over empty local state when user has not edited yet.

leanTasks.title: Quiet repository chat autosave HTTP logs
leanTasks.summary:
Stop autosave PUTs from flooding dev INFO logs while keeping request logging for other routes.
- Adjust requestLoggingMiddleware for repository-chat PUT
- Unit test log level/path filtering
leanTasks.context: requestLoggingMiddleware logs every API call at INFO; autosave PUTs are high frequency during typing pauses.
leanTasks.goal: Autosave PUTs are not logged at INFO in normal dev runs.
requirements: PUT /api/projects/repository-chat should not emit INFO [http] API request lines during autosave.
Other methods/paths continue to log at INFO unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Test proves repository-chat PUT is skipped or downgraded.
Manual typing still shows reduced [http] PUT noise compared to before.
implementationPlan: Update requestLoggingMiddleware to return early or log at debug for PUT pathname /api/projects/repository-chat.
Add tests/request-logging.test.ts and register in tests/run-tests.mjs.
assumptions: Debug-level logging for this path is sufficient; no UI toggle needed.
